definition.slot: bridge_choose(..., slot=...) counts only answers whose value[0] equals the slot; without slot the whole read is counted
definition.separate: one sentence with CUP and TABLE chooses CUP in object and TABLE in place, independently
definition.no_slot: the same two-entity sentence without slot is ambiguous_read
definition.slot_missing: a slot the sentence does not carry gives no_choice
definition.outside: a slot whose value is outside the candidates gives not_in_candidates
definition.same_slot_ambiguous: two entities of the same slot give ambiguous_read even with slot
definition.correction: correcting CUP to GREEN flips the object choice 0->1 while the place choice stays 0; the table digest moves and the subject hashes do not
definition.no_bridge: a state without a table gives no_bridge
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.slot_choice: object [RED,CUP] -> CUP index 1; place [SHELF,TABLE] -> TABLE index 1; object [CUP,RED] -> index 0; place [TABLE,SHELF] -> index 0
criteria.no_slot: two-entity sentence without slot -> ambiguous_read, answers=2
criteria.slot_missing: CUP-only sentence with slot=place -> no_choice, read_answers=1, answers=0
criteria.correction: before object 0 / place 0; after object 1 / place 0; table digest changes; hashes equal
criteria.inert: parameter and state hashes equal before and after all choices
criteria.no_bridge: a state without a table -> no_bridge
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R26 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
